title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree program in Computer Science or related technical field.
qualification: Pursuing degree in Computer Science or STEM subject
description: Work on impactful software projects, write production-ready code, and collaborate with senior Google engineers across various technology domains.

title: Rhodes Scholarship for International Students
eligibility: Outstanding young graduates under 25 years old from eligible constituency countries worldwide.
qualification: Completed undergraduate degree with first-class or high upper-second honours
description: Postgraduate awards supporting exceptional international students to study full-time at the University of Oxford.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open globally to candidates with strong fundamentals in Vue.js, JavaScript, and modern web development.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS or equivalent practical experience
description: Contribute to GitLab's open-core DevOps platform by writing clean frontend code, improving performance, and fixing bug issues.

title: Microsoft Imagine Cup Student Challenge
eligibility: Students aged 16+ enrolled in high school or higher education institutions globally.
description: Global tech competition encouraging student developers to build innovative solution prototypes addressing world issues using Microsoft Azure and AI.

title: Associate Data Scientist
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with experience in Python, SQL, and Machine Learning.
qualification: Bachelor's or Master's in Data Science, Statistics, or Computer Science
description: Transform complex client datasets into actionable strategic insights, develop statistical models, and assist enterprise AI implementations.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open globally to anyone interested in learning computer science fundamentals; no prior coding knowledge required.
description: An introductory course teaching algorithmic thinking and problem-solving using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
